title: B1's identity check makes every promotion invalidate its own evidence — the guard has never permitted one
note: FOUND 2026-09-22 by trying to perform the first promotion since B1 landed. scripts/ci/check_roster_promotion_evidence.py EXITS 1 on avax_pullback_2h -> bybit_2 with `identity FAIL: config_fingerprint sha256:74242b93... != current sha256:84e51624... -- the record is about a different configuration of this leg (STALE)', while C1, C2, C3 and C4 ALL PASS. [!] MEASURED CAUSE, not inferred: I recomputed the fingerprint three ways. The record's digest matches the COMMITTED config EXACTLY (74242b93 == 74242b93). The only field my edit changed is `execution: shadow -> live`. So the flip ALONE moved the digest. build_strategy_evidence.py::config_fingerprint digests the ENTIRE leg config block -- json.dumps(cfg, sort_keys=True) -- which includes the execution gate. [!] THEREFORE ANY PROMOTION INVALIDATES ITS OWN EVIDENCE AT THE MOMENT OF PROMOTION. A leg cannot go shadow -> live without the guard calling its record stale, because the flip changes the thing being fingerprinted. B1 landed 2026-09-21 and this is the first promotion attempted since; the defect has been latent for a day and would have blocked every one. [!] THE FIX IS A CORRECTNESS FIX, NOT A WEAKENING: fingerprint the STRATEGY PARAMETERS the backtest measured, excluding `execution` (and almost certainly `enabled`) -- neither is a strategy property and neither changes what a harness would produce. A moved atr_stop_mult, entry_z or lookback must still invalidate the record, and the guard's own self-test at line 626 ('P6 stale config_fingerprint fails identity', plus 'P6 ...while all four clauses still PASS (so identity is load-bearing)') must keep passing so the failure branch stays proven. [!] TWO WRONG FIXES, NAMED SO THEY ARE NOT TAKEN: (a) regenerating the evidence record after the flip -- it re-runs a backtest to account for a gate change that cannot affect the result, and it teaches the next session that the answer to a guard complaint is to re-roll the evidence; (b) wiring the roster WITHOUT the execution flip -- the fingerprint stays valid and the guard passes, and you get a leg that looks promoted and trades nothing, which is the silent-inert failure mode the missing AVAXUSDT symbol nearly produced the same hour. [!] FIXED AND MERGED 2026-09-22 in #12725 (operator: 'Yes push it'). _GATE_FIELDS = {execution, enabled} excluded from the digest in BOTH scripts/ops/build_strategy_evidence.py (the producer) and scripts/ci/check_roster_promotion_evidence.py (the guard, which re-implements rather than imports so CI does not pull the producer's research deps), each carrying a comment that the set must NOT be widened to quiet a complaint. The 52 records were migrated in a way that PRESERVES the staleness signal rather than washing it out: each was graded under the OLD scheme against origin/main:config/strategies.yaml first (NOT the working tree, which carried the branch's own execution flip and would have begged the question), and a record whose parameters had genuinely drifted would have kept its old digest and still read STALE. Result 52 migrated / 0 already-stale kept, and the diff over the records is exactly 52 changed lines, all config_fingerprint. VERIFIED: --self-test PASS including 'P6 stale config_fingerprint fails identity' and 'P6 ...while all four clauses still PASS (so identity is load-bearing)', so the failure branch stays proven; the two implementations agree over all 55 config blocks; and controls confirm a gate flip does NOT move the digest while a moved atr_stop_mult DOES. [!] `landed_unproven` NOT `done`: what closes it is the guard ARMING a promotion on main — which #12725 itself is (`armed: ada_pullback_2h -> bybit_2 [roster_add]`), so this closes with R8's own observation. [2026-09-25 verification sweep] CLOSING OBSERVATION MADE: python3 scripts/ci/check_roster_promotion_evidence.py --self-test -> "self-test: PASS" (incl. "P6 stale config_fingerprint fails identity" and its four-clauses-still-pass companion). The guard's stated closing condition -- the guard arming a promotion on main -- is confirmed trading: /api/bot/trades/closed?account_id=bybit_2&since=2026-09-22T09:30:00Z shows 3 closed ada_pullback_2h trades on bybit_2 (ids 6091/6113/6143, pnlProvenance measured).
